name: BRICK SNAKE 2000

features.name: Snek Spins
features.description: Extra scatters become sneks in the bonus.

review:
A retro arcade snake game on 5x5, with pixel art and chiptune music. The Wild Snek can land anywhere and slither one to five steps in any direction except backwards, turning everything it passes wild. xWays reveal stacks of two to five matching symbols.

Three or four scatters start Snek Spins (extra scatters become sneks), and five give Super Snek Spins. Rated Insane volatility, 8,110x max. One of Nolimit's most playful games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
